scope.deployment: one prefill GPU, one decode GPU
scope.hardware: two H800 PCIe, SYS topology; vLLM PyNccl SHM/direct/direct observed

items.name: kv_transfer_fee_basis
items.finding: Baseline charges (prefill_tokens+1)*KV bytes per token; DAG v1.0 charges prefill_tokens*KV bytes. Explicit v1.1 legacy_prefill_billing_extra_token sets the same fee basis without changing physical KV metadata. Synthetic TP1 PP1 single-request comparisons at 8,16,32 tokens passed with identical bandwidth and zero fixed latency; other TP/PP and nonzero latency are rejected by this mode.
items.remaining: Verify on target-length real-profile replay; keep physical payload and billed quantity distinct. Service also transfers hidden states, token and ROI tensors; independent serial bandwidth is only an approximation.

items.name: rope
items.finding: Actual Llama model uses theta 10000, no scaling; both baseline and DAG config use None and predictor returns zero for RoPE. CUDA event samples exist.
items.remaining: Integrate actual RoPE cost identically into both predictors without double counting and validate mapping.

items.name: fused_norm_and_attention
items.finding: Actual vLLM uses fused residual/RMSNorm and a combined attention/KV interval; predictor expects separate add, norm, attention and cache fields. Batched prefill uses sqrt(sum(length^2)) in predictor.
items.remaining: Fused operation mapping is explicit and context-aware profile smoke passes, but common server-arrival replay still overpredicts; validate overlap and service boundary before freeze.

items.name: model_boundary_and_sampling
items.finding: Embedding, final norm and output head were independently measured but predictor has no explicit fields. Producer samples once before sending hidden states; consumer samples its first token again from received hidden states.
items.remaining: Account for per-step and first-token work without multiplying it by 32 layers or double-counting sampler host time; synchronized sampler data confirms host/GPU overlap.

items.name: cpu_and_ipc
items.finding: Measured vLLM host call boundaries differ from Sarathi-derived predictor fields; sampler may include GPU wait. Router/frontend/IPC and PD connector CPU costs are not covered.
items.remaining: Establish consistent accounting of overlap, process boundaries and proxy E2E before freeze.

items.name: request_batch_and_transfer_identity
items.finding: Four unique equal-length 2048-token requests were mapped through producer and consumer batches using token SHA256; selected K, V and hidden slices matched between source and target, with distinct sample hashes per request and GPU-synchronized KVReady.
items.remaining: Full-tensor hashes and arbitrary shared-prefix/mixed-length workloads were not tested. Formal run requires low-overhead request/batch trace and the frozen input set must avoid ambiguous prefix matches.

items.name: arrival_completion_and_token_semantics
items.finding: Calibration server-arrival replay is now executable for 32 serial requests with both simulators; actual server completion and arrival events are paired by request ID.
items.remaining: Predicted medians overestimate the service metric by about 37% for both versions; align inclusive CPU/model-boundary and router/service completion semantics before freeze.

items.name: formal_inputs_costs_and_freeze
items.finding: Request-level calibration matrix 512/64 has been collected: 3 repeats x 32 serial + 32 concurrent2, all 192 requests successful. It remains a calibration artifact only; no fee fitting or parameter freeze has been performed.
items.remaining: Produce shared independently profiled cost files and calibration, resolve compatibility items, freeze all inputs and rules, then begin the 30 validation runs.
